title: servers.moderation_action_recorded
description: ModerationActionRecorded is published by servers every time a moderation action (ban, unban, kick, mute or unmute) is written to its audit log. Admin consumes it to build the investigation dossier of a user without asking servers. Meta.OccurredAt is the moment of the action, the same occurred_at as the audit log entry. An audit entry never changes, so the event is immutable: ActionID is the id of the audit entry and the idempotency key, and a repeated delivery with the same ActionID must be ignored. It carries neither the moderator who acted nor the reason (data minimization): the dossier is about the target user, and who acted is only needed inside servers.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

action_id.description: Id de la fila de `moderation_audit_entries` en servers. Sirve para deduplicar.

target_user_id.description: Usuario sobre el que se aplicó la acción (ID de discordia-identify).
